rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.MutuallyExclusive/FlagErrorf, heredoc.Docf, api.HandleHTTPError, safeurl and lowercase errors as the codebase does; but testify/testing are imported from a non-test file in a package linked into the binary, and the essay-style comments are far more verbose than surrounding code.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers symlink/hardlink dupes via os.SameFile, empty and '-' values, dirs, non-regular and empty files, size caps, video alt refusal, '#' in filenames, code spans/fences, reference definitions, blockquote continuations, escaped alt text and protocol-relative URLs.
rationale.scope: Implements every command and the package, but deliberately writes the body after a partial upload failure, contradicting 'if one upload fails nothing is written'; also restructures issue edit (hasDeferredEdits, moved issueTypeID lookup) beyond what the feature needs.
rationale.readability: Structure is clear and names are mostly good, but references.go is an 810-line hand-rolled byte scanner with near-homonym types (attachmentArg/attachmentRef/attachableMarkdown/attachedMarkdown) and many philosophical comments that obscure rather than explain.
rationale.robustness: Bounds checks throughout the scanner, nil block handling, GetBody for redirects, files closed, uploads sequential and stop at first failure, HTTP errors mapped to actionable messages; upload/write errors are joined rather than lost.
rationale.maintainability: Uploader construction, host/token lookup and identical help prose are copy-pasted across six commands; the custom markdown position scanner duplicates parsing goldmark already did and will be fragile to maintain; issue edit and pr edit handle the nothing-uploaded case differently.
